propositions: The documented curl command to install commit-msg hook resolves to shared hooks directory and clobbers pre-commit wrapper across all worktrees when run from linked worktrees.
Running the documented install silently breaks Change-Id stamping for every worktree on the host, with failure only surfacing later at git push to Gerrit.
Pre-commit migration mode chains both hooks (pre-commit wrapper and Gerrit stamper), but the documented bare curl replaces the wrapper non-destructively, breaking the chain.
The idempotent install script must refuse to overwrite a pre-commit wrapper, validate hook payload contains Change-Id logic, and install to commit-msg.legacy when wrapper is present.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove instruction to curl over git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg and direct users to make hooks instead.
